notes.title: New Game Mode Update
notes.content:
New Game:

 Memory Lights - a new colour sequence mini game, featuring increasing difficulty as you progress

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the colours of certain UI elements were incorrect
Fixed an issue where the end screen in Memory Cards was not reset when restarting the game
Fixed an issue where the game could potentially crash if the Snake grew too big

Changes:

Small improvement to certain parts of the UI
Changed version format from 0.0.0.0 to 0.0.0
